high_level_description: This infographic is a detailed visual representation of the "Top 10 Publications" by WikiLeaks, focusing on three major trade agreements: TPP (Trans-Pacific Partnership), TTIP (Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership), and TiSA (Trade in Services Agreement). The design uses a dark background with purple and white text to highlight key points. "WikiLeaks TOP 10 PUBLICATIONS" is prominently displayed at the top left corner. "8 | TPP, TTIP & TiSA" indicates that these three agreements are among the top publications.
